decision.explanation: Two distinct pieces of evidence point to two different languages being associated with the work or name 'Data retention in the telecommunications field: analysis of its regulation in the European Union and its fit into EU Law.' Document D1 (specifically D1S4 and D1S9) indicates the thesis is written in Spanish, supported by the title in Spanish and the academic institution's language. Document D2 (D2S3) explicitly states the analysis was conducted in English. These are separate references to the same work, likely indicating the work exists in both languages or was analyzed in English while originally written in Spanish. Both claims are valid and non-contradictory when considered as distinct referents.
